AffineConstructive.orders.subset.id.short: Local shorthand for the identity function on the set at hand

d: subset_poset is universe polymorphic and cumulative

AffineConstructive.orders.subset.subset_.short: The subsets of X, ordered by inclusion, form a poset

d: element_proper_aimpl is universe polymorphic and cumulative

AffineConstructive.orders.subset.element.short: If x = y and U ⊆ V, then x ∊ U implies y ∊ V

d: element_proper_le_aimpl is universe polymorphic and cumulative

AffineConstructive.orders.subset.element.short: For an up-set V, x ≤ y and U ⊆ V give that x ∊ U implies y ∊ V

d: element_proper_le_flip_aimpl is universe polymorphic and cumulative

AffineConstructive.orders.subset.element.short: For a down-set V, y ≤ x and U ⊆ V give that x ∊ U implies y ∊ V

d: subset_bounded_lattice_order is universe polymorphic and cumulative

AffineConstructive.orders.subset.subset_.short: Under inclusion 𝒫 X is a bounded lattice: meet, join, the full subset as top, ∅ as bottom
The lattice of subsets 𝒫 X is distributive

d: nonempty_alt is universe polymorphic and cumulative

AffineConstructive.orders.subset.nonempt.short: U ≠ ∅ if and only if there is a member of U

d: complement_involutive is universe polymorphic and cumulative

AffineConstructive.orders.subset.complem.short: The complement is an involution on 𝒫 X: Uᗮᗮ = U

d: complement_latmor_flip is universe polymorphic and cumulative

AffineConstructive.orders.subset.complem.short: The complement exchanges meet with join and the full subset with ∅

d: complement_order_embedding_flip is universe polymorphic and cumulative

AffineConstructive.orders.subset.complem.short: The complement reverses inclusion both ways: U ⊆ V if and only if Vᗮ ⊆ Uᗮ

d: powerset_pt_fun_order_embedding is universe polymorphic and cumulative

AffineConstructive.orders.subset.powerse.short: The inclusion of a set of subsets F into 𝒫 X is an order embedding

d: mult_intersection_commutative is universe polymorphic and cumulative

AffineConstructive.orders.subset.mult_in.short: The multiplicative intersection of subsets is commutative

d: mult_empty_subset_complement_l is universe polymorphic and cumulative

AffineConstructive.orders.subset.mult_em.short: There being no x with x ∊ U ⊠ x ∊ V is equivalent to U ⊆ Vᗮ

d: mult_empty_subset_complement_r is universe polymorphic and cumulative

AffineConstructive.orders.subset.mult_em.short: There being no x with x ∊ U ⊠ x ∊ V is equivalent to V ⊆ Uᗮ

d: mult_disjoint_subset_complement_l is universe polymorphic and cumulative

AffineConstructive.orders.subset.mult_di.short: Every x lying outside U par outside V is equivalent to U ⊆ Vᗮ

d: tensor_singleton is universe polymorphic and cumulative

AffineConstructive.orders.subset.tensor_.short: The singleton of (x, y) in X ⊗ Y is the tensor pairing {x} ⊗ {y}

d: singleton_subset is universe polymorphic and cumulative

AffineConstructive.orders.subset.singlet.short: {x} ⊆ U if and only if x ∊ U

d: of_course_subset is universe polymorphic and cumulative

AffineConstructive.orders.subset.of_cour.short: The points of X equal to some member of U, as the range of U's inclusion

d: of_course_subset_is_fun is universe polymorphic and cumulative

AffineConstructive.orders.subset.of_cour.short: An affirmed equality U = V gives equal subsets of_course_subset U and of_course_subset V

d: of_course_subset_fun is universe polymorphic and cumulative

AffineConstructive.orders.subset.of_cour.short: of_course_subset as a function of sets from !(𝒫 X) to 𝒫 X

d: of_course_subset_subset is universe polymorphic and cumulative

AffineConstructive.orders.subset.of_cour.short: of_course_subset U is contained in U

d: of_course_subset_order_preserving is universe polymorphic and cumulative

AffineConstructive.orders.subset.of_cour.short: of_course_subset, as a function on !(𝒫 X), preserves inclusion

d: of_course_singleton is universe polymorphic and cumulative

AffineConstructive.orders.subset.of_cour.short: of_course_subset of the singleton {x} is {x} itself

d: aex_subset_aiff is universe polymorphic and cumulative

AffineConstructive.orders.subset.aex_sub.short: There is a member of S with P if and only if there is x with x ∊ S affirmed (!) and P x

d: all_subset_aiff is universe polymorphic and cumulative

AffineConstructive.orders.subset.all_sub.short: P holds of every member of S if and only if, for every x, x ∊ S affirmed (!) implies P x

d: aex_subset is universe polymorphic and cumulative

AffineConstructive.orders.subset.aex_sub.short: Proving there is a member of S with P amounts to proving there is x with x ∊ S ⊠ P x

d: aex_subset_proper_aimpl is universe polymorphic and cumulative

AffineConstructive.orders.subset.aex_sub.short: For S ⊆ T, a pointwise implication carries an existential over S's members to one over T's

d: all_subset_proper_aimpl is universe polymorphic and cumulative

AffineConstructive.orders.subset.all_sub.short: For T ⊆ S, a pointwise implication carries a universal over S's members to one over T's

d: aex_subset_proper_aiff is universe polymorphic and cumulative

AffineConstructive.orders.subset.aex_sub.short: For S = T, a pointwise equivalence makes the existentials over S's and T's members equivalent

d: all_subset_proper_aiff is universe polymorphic and cumulative

AffineConstructive.orders.subset.all_sub.short: For S = T, a pointwise equivalence makes the universals over S's and T's members equivalent

d: sall_subset_proper_impl is universe polymorphic and cumulative

AffineConstructive.orders.subset.sall_su.short: For T ⊆ S, a base-logic universal over S's members implies one over T's, pointwise

d: sall_subset_proper_iff is universe polymorphic and cumulative

AffineConstructive.orders.subset.sall_su.short: For S = T, base-logic universals over S's and T's members are equivalent, pointwise
